en.name: Maharashtra Ration Card / Food Supply (MahaFood)
en.description: Maharashtra ration card issuance and PDS entitlements under NFSA/state schemes.
en.eligibility: Maharashtra households meeting NFSA/state poverty criteria.
en.benefits: Subsidised foodgrains via PDS; priority/APL/BPL categories.
application_steps: Apply via Maharashtra food supply portal / CSC.
faqs: How do I add a member to my ration card?

What is the official website for this service?
